title: Colimits of simplicial categories computed as ordinary categories in each degree
statement: Use small simplicial categories and enriched functors with arbitrary object functions as defined in [lem-coef-simplicial-interval-lifting], and colimits in the universal-property sense of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $I$ be any small ordinary category and $D:I\to\mathrm{sCat}$ a diagram. For a simplicial category $A$ and $r\geq0$, write $A_r$ for the ordinary category with object set $\operatorname{Ob}A$ and morphism sets $A(x,y)_r$, with degree-$r$ composition. Put $O=\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}\operatorname{Ob}D_i$ in sets. For every $r$, form the colimit $P_r=\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}(D_i)_r$ in small ordinary categories. The canonical map from $O$ to $\operatorname{Ob}P_r$ is a bijection. After these identifications, the simplicial operators on the $P_r$ are identity on $O$. The sets $\operatorname{Hom}_{P_r}(x,y)$, as $r$ varies, are the mapping simplicial sets of a simplicial category $P$ with object set $O$, and the induced cocone $D_i\to P$ is colimiting in $\mathrm{sCat}$. Thus evaluation $A\mapsto A_r$ preserves all small colimits, including pushouts, coproducts and sequential colimits. This statement includes the empty diagram and allows the diagram functors to identify objects.
